organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Central warehouse and redistribution center for 20 member pantries. Racked warehouse with temperature-controlled bays and a monitored freezer. We run our own refrigerated box truck and can collect within a few hours of a call.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 4% of residents below the poverty line, 32% of households without a vehicle, 0% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Top Box Foods team,

A grocer in Chicago has 6 cases of frozen chicken. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 24 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 10 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
